no: In 2008, Alexei Myakishev gave the following construction of a conic. Let C_{A} and C_{B} be points on the line AB satisfying \| BC_{A} \| = \|CB\| and \| AC_{B} \| = \|CA\| and arranged in this order: C_{A}, B, A, and C_{B}.
